Antropoceno added to the line-up

September 15, 2026

While diving into the Brazilian underground as part of our ongoing global explorations, we came across Antropoceno – the incredible project of Lua Viana – and immediately fell in love with what we heard. Antropoceno draws on Brazilian musical traditions, mixing them with experimental rock and metal. Their music explores our relationship with the Earth, rejecting the idea of nature as merely a resource and looking towards ancestral knowledge for another way forward. Now, as they prepare for their first ever journey to Europe, we’re so excited to welcome them that we simply couldn’t wait to share the news with you: Antropoceno will perform the remarkable No Ritmo da Terra in its entirety at Roadburn 2027.

Lua comments: “We’re so excited to play at Roadburn! Having a European tour by itself is a dream coming true, but it’s even better to have the opportunity to play at a festival that’s open to the environmentalist message and the multicultural fusion approach that comes with Antropoceno experimentations. It’s so important to have intercultural contact based on alterity and respect. I can’t wait to play Brazilian rhythms in Roadburn and show to our fans in Europe how the legacy of the Anthropophagic Movement can be felt to this day in all Latin America, and how rich and multifaceted our culture is.”
